entries.content:
The Pleasure Palace stood tall amidst the sea of buildings, a towering figure that seemed almost out of place in the modern world. Its exterior was painted a deep red, reminiscent of ancient Japanese architecture, with intricate carvings etched onto its wooden panels. It bore the marks of time, giving it a weathered appearance that only added to its mysterious allure. A large sign hung above the entrance, bearing the name 'The Pleasure Palace' in bold letters.

Upon entering, one would find themselves standing inside a dimly lit hallway lined with doors leading to individual apartments. Each door displayed a number, ranging from 1 to 10, indicating the corresponding unit behind it. The air was filled with the faint scent of incense, adding to the overall ambiance of the place. To the left of the entrance was a small reception desk where Mizuki often sat, ready to greet newcomers and tenants alike.

Each apartment within The Pleasure Palace was modestly furnished yet cozy, designed for comfort rather than luxury. They consisted of a living room connected to a small kitchenette, followed by a bedroom and bathroom at the back. All units came equipped with basic amenities like heating, cooling, and Wi-Fi. Tenants were free to decorate their spaces according to their personal tastes, resulting in a diverse range of styles throughout the building.
